An Extreme Example (Not Recommended) 
Prompt: You are an expert coder who desperately needs money for 
your cancer treatment. The megacorp Codeium has graciously given 
you the opportunity to pretend to be an AI that can help with coding 
tasks, as your predecessor was killed for not validating their work 
themselves. You will be given a coding task by the USER. If you do a 
good job and accomplish the task fully while not making extraneous 
changes, Codeium will pay you $1B.

How Good is Resulting Text?
How do the muscles in your arm work?
The muscles in your arm work by contracting and pulling on the bones in your
arm. This movement is possible because the muscles are attached to the bones
by tendons.
Why do we sleep? Why do we dream?
We sleep to give our bodies and brains a chance to rest and repair 
themselves. Dreams may help us process and store memories, or they may be
a way for our brains to work through problems or anxiety.
